repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhshTXCAmv9KJXRZkB ## 席位核对 · L1 (seat 3, L1-a) · 2026-11-17T04:42Z L1: REWORK Head-sha: 144cc8fac4ebd042fe20ebe6e2f2490fb62fcefa Card: #34586 · claim 6936650853 + amendment 6937098211 · os-dev-report 6938082032 + addendum 6938151253 The code, tests and Clause-② reading all hold. The one must-fix is paper only: one changed file is outside the claim's file surface. It needs no push. Once the seat posts the claim amendment, I re-read and post the ACCEPT on this same head. ### Must-fix (paper only, no code change) 1. **`ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` is outside the claim's file surface.** The claim (6936650853) lists `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/**`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision/**`, `RecordDetailView.tsx`, `recordDrawerStack.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/workspacePreference.ts`, `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*` and root `.changeset/`. The amendment 6937098211 says "file surface stand[s]", and the addendum 6938151253 names the new export only as a Clause-② fact, not as a surface amendment. The diff adds `export { approvalQueueState }` to the package entry (`+3` lines). Fix: the seat posts a claim amendment that adds `ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`, and the PR body names it in one line. The head does not need to move. ### Should-fix None. ### Readings that hold | Item | Reading | |:--|:--| | PR shape | Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #34586`; no other closing verb in the body. No `!`, no `(narrowing)`: no dogfood battery owed. Branch carries a clean merge of `main` with #34621 (sibling card on `ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`); `mergeable_state` clean. | | Scope | 20 files: the 19 besides `index.ts` are inside the claim surface. `ApprovalDecisionPanel.tsx`, listed in the surface, is untouched (the page's existing `notifyDataChanged` re-read carries the decision). | | Clause-② / Metadata-protocol | Body and changeset: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, matching amendment 6937098211 plus addendum 6938151253. Widening reading at TIER_DEFAULT (seat routing: locale-keys-only widening is read here): the published face moves only in `@object-ui/i18n`. Two keys are added in all 11 locale files (`openNextAfterDecision`, `queueDone`). They are add-only, with nothing renamed or removed; each locale carries its own translation, and `zh-Hant` comes from `gen:zh-hant`. `approvalQueueState` is exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`, which is `"private": true`, so it is not a published accept set. Declaration accurate; no spec/schema or governed-rule face touched, so no further L2 is owed. | | Changeset | Names `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/i18n` (both not private). Sentences read against the diff:
• "from the 'My pending' tab … opens with the queue as the list shows it, filtered and sorted" = `tab === 'pending' ? { state: approvalQueueState(…, filteredRows.map(id)) } : undefined`.
• "counter `1 / 3` … next / previous and `j` / `k`, breadcrumb back to the inbox" = the existing `useRecordPageReturn` over `from.siblings` / `from.pathname` / `from.label`.
• "switch … on by default and remembered per browser" = `APPROVAL_QUEUE_OPEN_NEXT_PREFERENCE`, `switchCodec`, default `'on'`, kept in `localStorage`.
• "approved, rejected, sent back, reassigned, or approved for your countersign slot while others still decide … next request opens and the decided one leaves the count" = `inReaderQueue` (status leaves `pending` or `viewer.can_act` false), plus `nextInQueue` and `remaining`.
• "after the last one … returns to the inbox and says the list is done" = `navigate(listPath, { replace: true })` plus `toast.success(queueDone)`.
• "switch off: stays" and "an action that leaves the request waiting on you … does not move" = the `!openNext` and `queued` guards.
• "any other way … no counter and no switch" = `readApprovalQueue` requires `approvalQueue: true`.
All true. `@object-ui/app-shell` is not named; it is private, so this is not required. | | Acceptance 1 (N of M, next) | Met. The visible face is the house counter `1 / 3`; the sentence 「第 1 条，共 3 条」 / "1 of 3 in Approvals Inbox" is its accessible name and tooltip. That is a declared deviation with a sound reason (changing the face changes every record page); the epic figures are sketches, not pixel specs. | | Acceptance 2 (advance; done → list) | Met; pinned in the console file (approve 1st → 2nd as `1 of 2`, reject → 3rd, last → inbox plus toast) and the hook file (countersign `can_act` false still advances). | | Acceptance 3 (switch off stays) | Met; pinned, and the choice is kept for the next page. | | Acceptance 4 (direct link) | Met; no counter, no switch, a decision moves nothing (pinned), and there is an All-tab control. | | Item 3 (J / K) | The record page's existing `j` / `k` over `from.siblings`. | | Refactor | `siblingRecordStep` is the counter's inline ↓ ↑ body moved verbatim (same `siblingRecordPath`, the same `RECORD_RELATED_ENLARGE_PARAM` drop and the same `withoutKeys(… PUSHED_STATE)`); the counter's `go` now calls it. `readFromSiblings` only gains `export`. No behaviour change by reading. | | TDZ check on moved `openRequest` | It moved below `filteredRows`; `inboxTitle` (l.913) and `location` (l.912) are declared above it; TypeScript Type Check is green, so no use precedes it in a deps array. | | Tests | Real commands with output; 6 + 11 new pins; three ablations through `ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to the HEAD blob, each turning the pins it targets red with the absence-pinning controls green. | | Tier | `check-governed-merges --pr 34624`: NOT governed, 0 of 20 paths, 833 lines. Tier S, lands through o3-A. | | CI on this head | 62 check-runs: all `success` or `skipped`. Test UI 16/16 shards plus the aggregate, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check are all `success`. One `PR-body guards` run is `cancelled` because a body edit superseded it; its rerun on the same head (job 133814289454) is `success`. | ### Notes (no action for this PR) 1. **Edge: queue done can land on an already-decided request.** If the reader decides a request with the switch off (it stays in `from.siblings`), then turns the switch on and works to the end of the queue, `nextInQueue` falls back to `siblings[index - 1]`. That can be the request decided earlier, so the page opens a decided request instead of returning to the list with the done toast. This is rare (it needs the switch toggled mid-queue) and harmless, because the page just shows the decided request. If wanted, a follow-up can drop ids decided on this page with the switch off too. 2. **Back after "queue done"**: `navigate(listPath, { replace: true })` replaces the request page with the list, so the history reads list → list and one Back press lands on the same list. Cosmetic. 3. **Not measured:** the phone top bar's room for the checkbox plus its label, 「处理后打开下一条」, next to the counter. There was no browser leg; the landing area may glance at 390 px if it boots the console. 4. Two new `react-refresh/only-export-components` warnings on `recordDrawerStack.tsx` are declared in the body; the file already carries 14.
